value.syntax: # [doc = " A container whose head has been read and whose items have not."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `start` is where the container's own head began, which becomes the"] # [doc = " start of the finished value — the byte range a map needs to compare its"] # [doc = " keys by."] # [derive (Debug)] enum Frame { Array { items : Vec < Value > , remaining : usize , indefinite : bool , start : usize , } , Map { entries : Vec < (Value , Value) > , remaining : usize , indefinite : bool , pending_key : Option < Value > , previous_key : Option < (usize , usize) > , start : usize , } , Tag { number : u64 , start : usize , } , }
